segments.title: This animal poops cubes
segments.say: This animal poops cubes. Real cubes.

segments.title: Not from a square bottom
segments.say: Scientists found the cubes are not shaped on the way out.

segments.title: Shaped inside the gut
segments.say: They take shape inside the gut, which has stiff and stretchy zones.

segments.title: Four stiff zones = 4 walls
segments.say: Four stiff zones could make the four walls of a cube.

segments.title: COMMENT BELOW
